check_update.description: Whether to check for updates when starting HTTPie.

color_scheme.description: The color scheme to use for output. Options: auto, base16-eighties.dark, base16-eighties.light, base16-mocha.dark, base16-mocha.light, base16-ocean.dark, base16-ocean.light, bw, emacs, friendly, colorful, dracula, github-dark, monokai, monokai-clair, onedark, paraiso.dark, paraiso.light, pastel-dark, ratpoison, sas, solarized, solarized-dark, solarized-light, tango, xterm-256.

default_http_headers.description: A list of default HTTP headers to send with every request. Each item is a map with 'name' and 'value' keys. Note: In values_schema, this is defined as a list of flat maps to ensure JSON serializability without nested properties schema complexity, but the default is an empty list. For non-empty defaults, use the sample_values format or provide a list of objects in values. To keep schema strict scalar/array, we define items as flat map. However, per instructions: 'items' as a FLAT map field-name -> {type, default, description}. So we need to adjust schema structure for list-of-objects.

default_options.description: A list of default options (flags) to apply to every httpie invocation.

proxy_no_proxy.description: Comma-separated list of hosts that should not use a proxy.

verify.description: Whether to verify SSL certificates. Options: yes, no, /path/to/cert/file.
